# Conscious
AI journaling/reflection platform prototype. Goal: help users notice patterns in their weeks.

## Usage
echo 'entry1

entry2' | python app.py  # themes + mood trend per entry

## Per-student patterns (from tutor feedback)
`per_session({"alice":[...],"bob":[...]})` returns top themes, mood series and trend per student.

## Civic angle
Tutors, counselors and community orgs can spot struggling students early via mood trends. Run `python test_app.py` to test.
